title: Seals inoperative.
bodyText: The affixing of a seal to a record evidencing a lease contract or an offer to enter into a lease contract does not render the record a sealed instrument and the law with respect to sealed instruments does not apply to the lease contract or offer.
bodyHtml: §490:2A-203  Seals inoperative.  The affixing of a seal to a record evidencing a lease contract or an offer to enter into a lease contract does not render the record a sealed instrument and the law with respect to sealed instruments does not apply to the lease contract or offer. [L 1991, c 40, pt of §1; am L 2023, c 132, §64]
